d: We are seeking creative, organized, and results-oriented professionals for the positions of Digital Marketing Assistant / Digital Transformation Manager. These roles focus on digital marketing activities, online engagement, technology adoption, business process improvement, and the development of effective digital strategies. The ideal candidates should demonstrate strong communication skills, analytical thinking, adaptability, and a commitment to innovation and continuous improvement.

As a Digital Marketing Assistant, you will support the planning, execution, and monitoring of digital marketing campaigns across various online channels. Responsibilities include preparing marketing content, updating digital platforms, scheduling social media posts, assisting with email marketing activities, and monitoring audience engagement. You will collaborate with marketing and creative teams to maintain consistent brand messaging, coordinate promotional activities, and support the development of digital campaigns. Additional duties may include conducting market research, analyzing campaign performance, maintaining marketing calendars, organizing digital assets, and preparing reports on website traffic and audience behavior. You will also help identify opportunities to improve online visibility, strengthen customer engagement, and enhance the effectiveness of marketing initiatives.

As a Digital Transformation Manager, you will oversee initiatives that integrate digital technologies into business operations to improve efficiency, productivity, and organizational performance. Responsibilities include evaluating existing processes, identifying opportunities for digital improvement, developing transformation strategies, and coordinating the implementation of technology-driven solutions. You will work with business leaders, technical teams, and stakeholders to define objectives, establish priorities, and ensure that digital initiatives align with organizational goals. Additional duties may include managing transformation projects, monitoring implementation progress, assessing business performance, supporting change management, and evaluating the impact of new technologies. You will also contribute to process automation, digital innovation, and the development of effective technology adoption strategies.

Both positions require strong organizational abilities, effective communication, and a practical understanding of digital environments. Successful candidates will contribute to stronger online engagement, improved operational processes, effective technology adoption, and sustainable business development.
A degree or diploma in Digital Marketing, Marketing, Business Administration, Information Technology, Management, or a related discipline.
Strong understanding of digital platforms, online communication, business processes, and performance measurement.
Familiarity with social media management, content creation, email marketing, and digital campaign coordination.
Knowledge of digital analytics, search engine optimization, and online advertising tools is an advantage.
Understanding of digital transformation, process improvement, project coordination, and technology implementation is beneficial for transformation roles.
Ability to interpret performance data, identify improvement opportunities, and prepare clear reports.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and relevant digital productivity tools.
Familiarity with analytics platforms, content management systems, project management software, or automation tools is an advantage.
Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail.
Effective written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams.
Ability to manage priorities, adapt to changing requirements, and support multiple initiatives.
A proactive attitude, creative thinking, and commitment to continuous learning, innovation, and professional development.

Hitachi, Ltd. is seeking a talented Electrical Engineer to contribute to the design, development, and testing of innovative electrical systems and components. This role involves applying electrical engineering principles to create robust and efficient solutions across various Hitachi product lines.
q: Bachelor's or master's degree in electrical engineering or a related field.
Experience in electrical design and development, preferably in a relevant industry (e.g., power systems, industrial automation, automotive, electronics).

Proficiency with electrical CAD software (e.g., Altium Designer, OrCAD, Eagle) for schematic capture and PCB layout.

Familiarity with various electrical components, sensors, and actuators.
Knowledge of safety standards (e.g., UL, CE) and regulatory requirements.
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks effectively.

d: noqodi grows faster through partners than on its own. This role finds, signs and manages the fintech partnerships that bring noqodi new customers, new products and new revenue: fintechs and platforms that embed noqodi's gateway, wallet and acquiring; providers whose products noqodi adds to its platform; and channels that let customers fund and use their noqodi wallets.
The Manager owns each partnership from first conversation to signed contract, launch and ongoing performance, and makes sure every partnership earns its place commercially
Build noqodi's fintech partnership strategy with the Director – Commercials, in line with the commercial plan and product roadmap.
Map the UAE and regional fintech landscape and identify the partners that add the most customers, products or revenue.
Build and manage a pipeline of partnership opportunities, prioritised by commercial value and fit.
Lead negotiations from first meeting to signed agreement.
Structure the commercial model for each partnership: revenue share, referral fees, licence and implementation fees, white-label and wholesale pricing.
Build the business case for each deal with Business Intelligence, showing expected volumes, revenue, cost and margin.
Prepare term sheets, MoUs and partnership agreements with Legal, and make sure terms protect noqodi's revenue, data and exclusivity rights.
Assess each partner's financial strength, technology, security and regulatory standing with Compliance, Risk and IT.
Support strategic opportunities such as licensing, joint ventures or investments, working with external advisers on due diligence.
Take partnership proposals through internal approvals and, where needed, to management and the board.
Work with Product and IT to plan and deliver each integration, from technical scoping to go-live.
Agree the go-to-market plan with each partner: target customers, joint offers, marketing and sales enablement.
Make sure operations, settlement, reconciliation and support are ready before launch.
Track each partnership's volumes, revenue, active customers and service levels against its business case.
Hold regular business reviews with each partner and agree actions to grow the partnership or fix issues.
Check, with Revenue Assurance, that partner revenue shares and fees are calculated, billed and collected correctly.
Recommend renewing, expanding, renegotiating or ending each partnership based on its results.
Track fintech trends, new players and competitor partnerships in the UAE and the region.
Follow Central Bank of the UAE regulation that affects partnerships, including stored value, retail payment services and open finance.
Represent noqodi at fintech events and in industry forums, and build relationships with fintech hubs and investors.
q: Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics or a related field.
MBA or a relevant postgraduate qualification is an advantage.
8+ years in partnerships, alliances, business development or corporate development in payments, fintech or banking.
A track record of signing and growing commercial partnerships with measurable revenue results.
Experience negotiating revenue share, licensing and white-label agreements.
Experience with a payment gateway, acquirer, wallet, BNPL, issuing processor or card scheme is a strong advantage.
An existing network across the UAE fintech and payments ecosystem is a strong advantage.
The payments value chain: gateways, acquiring, payment facilitators, schemes, issuing, wallets and settlement.
Payment methods including cards, tokenised wallets, BNPL, Aani and account-to-account payments.
How integrations work: APIs, SDKs, hosted pages and settlement files.
Partnership economics: MDR, interchange, revenue share and unit economics.
UAE payments regulation, including the Central Bank's stored value, retail payment services and open finance frameworks.
Strong negotiator who closes deals that work for both sides.
Commercial and analytical: builds and tests business cases.
Builds trust with founders, senior executives and technical teams.
Clear writer and presenter, comfortable presenting to management and the board.
Manages many partners and projects at once, and follows through to launch.

d: As a Trader at Thndr, you will play a critical role in supporting our Saudi brokerage dealing-desk capability and ensuring reliable day-to-day trading activity on the Saudi Exchange (Tadawul).

You will monitor automated order flow and trading activity, oversee the performance of trading systems, identify unusual activity, spikes, exceptions, or potential issues, and take appropriate action or escalate when required. You will work closely with Operations, Risk, Compliance, Product, and Engineering teams to ensure trading activity remains accurate, controlled, and compliant with applicable CMA requirements.

If you have hands-on trading experience in the Saudi market, strong knowledge of Tadawul and trading systems, and the ability to identify and respond to trading issues quickly and accurately, this role is for you.
q: Saudi national (Saudi citizenship is required for this role).
Hands-on Trader/Dealer experience at a CMA-licensed brokerage or Tadawul member firm.
Strong practical knowledge of Tadawul trading systems, order types, and market activity .
Strong understanding of the Saudi trading lifecycle , including order submission, clearing, and settlement.
Experience monitoring trading activity, identifying exceptions or unusual patterns, and escalating issues appropriately.
Meets the CMA qualification requirements for the function, including CME-3A and CME-3B , a qualifying previous-series certificate, or a CMA-granted exemption.
Eligible for CMA Registered Person registration and able to meet the applicable KSA residency requirements.
Strong attention to detail, sound judgement, and the ability to remain calm and responsive under pressure.
Existing working relationships with relevant Tadawul teams.
Experience with automated trading or electronic brokerage platforms.
Experience with trade surveillance, transaction monitoring, or trading-system monitoring.
Experience preparing trading reports or providing market insights.
Experience working with Product or Engineering teams to improve trading systems, controls, or order handling.
Previous experience in a fast-growing or technology-driven brokerage environment.

Thndr was founded on a bold dream to democratize access to investing through smart tech and human-centric design. This is simply our way of saying we give anyone with a smartphone the simple and easy access they need to preserve and grow their wealth. At the same time, we’re shaping the future of investing while actively driving the economies we serve by promoting local investment products.
History has shown that investing is the single greatest way to build long-term wealth, but before Thndr, only a very small percentage of people had access to it due to:
High barriers to entry — In the form of excessive minimum account balances, complex, outdated onboarding, and low financial literacy.
Irrelevant experience — Catered toward expert traders and financial specialists, therefore alienating the majority of the population.
Fragmented offering — Investment products were not gathered in a single, intuitive outlet.
We don't just talk about change, we deliver it. Here's a glimpse into our impact so far:
EGP 1B+ average daily traded value across 2025
#1 digital investing platform in Egypt for the third consecutive year
40% of our users come from outside of capital cities and have previously had limited access to financial institutions
At Thndr, we're looking for people driven by our mission to help us democratize investing across the MENA region.
r: Monitor automated client order flow and trading activity throughout the trading session.
Oversee trading-system performance and identify unusual activity, spikes, anomalies, or potential issues.
Monitor order status and identify rejected, delayed, or irregular orders.
Investigate trading exceptions and determine the appropriate action or escalation.
Escalate trading issues promptly to the relevant teams when intervention is required.
Monitor market conditions and assess their potential impact on trading activity.
Maintain accurate and auditable records of trading activity, exceptions, and incidents.
Ensure trading activity is conducted in line with applicable CMA regulations, market rules, and internal controls.
Apply pre-trade controls and trading limits and monitor adherence to established trading parameters.
Work closely with Risk and Compliance on trade surveillance and the identification and escalation of suspicious or unusual trading activity.
Support the investigation and documentation of trading incidents, errors, and potential market-abuse concerns.
Exercise sound judgement and maintain a high level of integrity when monitoring trading activity.
Maintain a strong understanding of the Saudi trading lifecycle, from order submission through clearing and settlement.
Coordinate with Operations on trade confirmations, clearing, and settlement through Edaa and Muqassa .
Communicate with relevant Tadawul teams when resolving trading, system, or operational issues.
Support the resolution of trading exceptions and ensure issues are appropriately documented and followed through.
Work closely with Operations, Risk, Compliance, Product, and Engineering teams to investigate and resolve trading issues.
Provide trading observations and market insights to the Head of Brokerage.
Partner with Product and Engineering to identify system issues and improve automated order handling and monitoring.
Contribute to improving trading controls, monitoring processes, and the overall client trading experience.
